'''Raim-Ner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a small vendor stand selling [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] on the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] [[Promenade]].
